Body.Content:
Folder sharing in Outlook will respect your organization's restrictions for Default and Anonymous permissions. When these restrictions are enabled, you won't be able to change either setting. Permissions granted directly to individual users will remain unaffected. This helps keep folder sharing aligned with your organization's policies. #newoutlookforwindows

GA date: January CY2027
